rows.title: The hedged lane
rows.body: Clipped hedges hug both sides of the road, with white lamps along the edge. You look through as you pass.
rows.placement: Hedge rows at 7 m spacing in the first verge row. White flowers fill the verges. Detected trees within 3 cells of the road edge use rounded crowns; no extra trees. One ambush where space permits.

rows.title: Gone to seed
rows.label: Overgrown Lane
rows.body: Seedlings grow into tall pines along the verge, then give way to bare trunks and stumps.
rows.flash: The green is taking it back.
rows.placement: One verge row with one empty cell between trees. Equal groups of seedlings, young pines, large pines, dead trees, then stumps; group size follows road length. The shrine sits after the stumps. A concealed seed cache rolls themed T1–T3 loot; enter its cell or tap it to reveal it.

rows.title: Orchard Lane
rows.body: Apples hang from the old orchard trees.
rows.placement: Fruit trees and mature maples alternate on both sides every 12 m, up to 80 per line piece. Fruit trees are mostly apples, with occasional oranges and Worldpeaches. Flowers and stumps use the first verge row only; blocked seats are omitted. A concealed themed T1–T3 cache reveals on exact-cell contact or a direct tap.

rows.title: Pilgrim's Way
rows.body: A neat row of smooth stones lines the verge. Step on each to keep them glowing together.
rows.placement: 3-6 waystones scattered within the two-cell verge. Step on all before their light fades. A concealed themed T1–T3 cache reveals on exact-cell contact or a direct tap.

rows.title: Lantern Row
rows.body: Lamp posts line the road, close enough to light the whole street. You walk between the rows of lamps.
rows.placement: Lamps spaced about 8.333333333333334 m apart.

rows.title: Burned Row
rows.body: Hot embers glow between the road stones, burning like lava underfoot. Tar fills the gutters, and iron stakes jut from the verge.
rows.placement: Hot ember paving, tar, stakes and torches. Up to 100 debris pieces per line piece; one fire-slime guard site per stretch.

rows.title: The barricade
rows.body: Rough barricades cross the road and reach into the verges. Iron spikes stand between the wooden barriers.
rows.placement: Barriers cross the road every 50 m and extend up to 3 cells beyond it. A Trap Kit removes each piece. Rocks, planks and stray stakes scatter across the three-cell verge. Goblins guard the route.

rows.title: Toadstool Lane
rows.body: Red toadstools crowd the verge, and the air smells of damp earth. You step around their spotted caps.
rows.placement: Small and medium mushrooms grow on the road and both two-cell verges, with occasional giants; 30% of candidate caps are omitted. Groups every 6 m; up to 200 extra caps.

rows.title: The promenade
rows.body: The path runs along the water. You listen to it lapping against the shore as you walk.
rows.rewards: 2× first-restoration credit. One T5 vista chest per eligible stretch of at least 120 m, collected once.
rows.placement: Vista chests sit beside the path.

rows.title: A greenway
rows.body: Branches hang low over the path. You duck beneath them as leaves brush your hood.
rows.selection: Walking path with a greenway name or route.
rows.rewards: 1.75× first-restoration credit. One T5 vista chest per eligible stretch of at least 120 m, collected once.
rows.placement: Vista chests sit beside the path. Grass grows along both verges every 10 m where space permits.

rows.title: The park path
rows.body: Weeds crowd the old park path, and dry leaves cover its edges. You follow it through the overgrowth.
rows.selection: Walking path in a named or large park.
rows.rewards: 1.75× first-restoration credit. One T5 vista chest per eligible stretch of at least 120 m, collected once.
rows.placement: Vista chests sit beside the path.

rows.title: Snare Lane
rows.body: A chest sits beside the lane, surrounded by iron traps. Open jaws stretch across the road and both verges.
rows.placement: Dirt extends 3 cells, with scattered rocks and bones. One T3 chest surrounded by 8-24 traps. Up to 12 extra snares lie along the road and verges.

rows.title: Thorny Way
rows.body: Tangled brambles crowd both sides of the road. You follow the narrow opening between their thorns.
rows.placement: Bramble clusters cross the road and extend up to 3 cells beyond it. Some streets enclose a moss cairn. Brambles burn and drain energy on contact.

rows.title: Goblin Gang Street
rows.body: Goblin grunts gather in little gangs beside stacks of barrels along the street.
rows.placement: Up to 6 gangs beside stacks of 5 barrels, where space permits. Red barrels always explode; 10% of ordinary barrels do too. Tap starts a five-second fuse before a one-cell blast and fire.

rows.title: Golden Path
rows.body: A gilded shrine stands beside the path. Touch it each day, and green coins appear in a line down the path.
rows.placement: Either end shrine starts the same daily coin run along the path.

rows.title: Slime Trail
rows.body: Wet slime gleams across the path. A colony of slimes has claimed this trail.
rows.placement: One slime species per section. Two guards per eligible post, spaced 70 m apart; short sections use the midpoint.

rows.title: Spider Path
rows.body: Lasting webs lie scattered across the path. Spiders lurk nearby; touching silk briefly pins you in place.
rows.placement: Permanent webs on 35% of eligible samples. Webs also occupy 20% of eligible off-path verge cells. Contact paralyses grounded actors. One two-spider garrison and a concealed supply cache per eligible section. A concealed themed T1–T3 cache reveals on exact-cell contact or a direct tap.

rows.title: Poison Path
rows.body: Poison geysers erupt beside the path. A shrine offers a daily boon along the way.
rows.placement: poison geysers beside the path, with a matching daily shrine on eligible sections.

rows.title: Fire Path
rows.body: Fire geysers erupt beside the path. A shrine offers a daily boon along the way.
rows.placement: fire geysers beside the path, with a matching daily shrine on eligible sections.

rows.title: Paralysis Path
rows.body: Creeping vines spread beneath the paralysis geysers. Their tendrils sting on contact. A shrine offers a daily boon along the way.
rows.placement: paralysis geysers beside the path, with a matching daily shrine on eligible sections. A concealed themed T1–T3 cache reveals on exact-cell contact or a direct tap.

rows.title: Confusion Path
rows.body: Confusion geysers erupt beside the path. A shrine offers a daily boon along the way.
rows.placement: confusion geysers beside the path, with a matching daily shrine on eligible sections. A concealed themed T1–T3 cache reveals on exact-cell contact or a direct tap.

rows.title: Berry Lane
rows.body: Ordinary and berry bushes line both verges, with occasional poison berries, thorns and golden berries. Something small may be hiding behind them.

rows.title: Berry Trail
rows.body: Berry bushes crowd the trail edge, with a few poison berries and thorns. A large bear watches the fruit.
rows.placement: Two bush rows on each side: 48% plain, 25% berry, 15% poison, 10% thorn and 2% golden. One large bear encounter per section.

rows.title: Pottery Road
rows.body: Clay pots stand along both sides of the road. Most are empty, but a coin rolls out of the odd one you smash.
rows.placement: Clay pots sit on the road and in two verge rows where space permits. Eligible surface pots have a 20% snake chance.

rows.title: Trade Row
rows.body: Barrels of goods line both sides of the road, and goblin grunts pick through them in twos.
rows.placement: Barrels line both verges with 30% gaps. Thief-and-two-grunt posts are sampled every 25 m; 67% are occupied.

rows.title: Rocky Road / Path
rows.label: Rocky Road
rows.body: Loose stones and low rocks line this simple route.
rows.placement: Common rocks, flint and rubble occupy the road and first verge row, with paired clear sections for cave-ins. Hidden cave-ins crack on contact, then open after five seconds; the preview shows intact ground.

rows.title: Grassy Lane
rows.body: Grass covers the road and its grassy verges.

rows.title: Old Growth Path
rows.body: Mature trees shade a path edged with mushrooms.
rows.placement: undefined A concealed themed T1–T3 cache reveals on exact-cell contact or a direct tap.

rows.title: Haunt
rows.body: Dead trees crowd the way. Old headstones stand among the mushrooms.
rows.placement: Permanent maws alternate between the route and verge, with one opportunity every 70 m. Each drops grounded players one level. Dead trees, headstones and mushrooms surround them. A concealed themed T1–T3 cache reveals on exact-cell contact or a direct tap.

rows.title: Way of Variety
rows.body: Herbs, crops, mushrooms, rocks and pots crowd the way, with occasional copper and rose quartz.
rows.placement: Common finds cover the road and two-cell verges, with occasional T1–T2 crop plants, copper and rose quartz. No added trees. Up to three small snakes per eligible tile habitat.

rows.title: Causeway
rows.body: Pools of water flank the raised road. The crossing stays dry.
rows.placement: Rocky ground extends up to 3 cells beside both verges, with water pools. Road surfaces and crossings stay dry.

baseline.title: Old Trade Road
baseline.body: Deep wheel ruts run past the remains of broken wagons. You follow the old trade road.
